parent_objective: bounded terminal-boundary materialization test from M1226 source-diverse action-divergent candidates
blocked_by: M1222 action-divergent rows do not yet show margin-threshold or success-drop degradation under source geometry
supersedes: directly claiming outcome evidence from M1222 action gaps
invalidates: assuming action divergence alone is a causal-history proof row

public_gates: M1227 may run bounded relocation replay only on M1226 exported candidates
M1227 must preserve actor input contract
M1227 must not use private holdout
M1227 must report source-diverse accepted rows or a clear negative result
M1227 must not claim self-identification unless outcome degradation is source-diverse and explicitly scoped
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not weaken M1226 candidate thresholds
do not claim action divergence as outcome evidence
do not accept a single-source active set as proof

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the first bounded relocation replay over M1226 source-diverse action-divergent candidates to test whether action gaps can be materialized into margin or success degradation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: bounded public proof smoke only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if relocation accepted rows are zero or collapse to one source family
stop if source budget fails before replay
stop if runtime or artifact volume exceeds bounded smoke scope
fallback_plan: if no accepted rows appear, route to stronger terminal/fault source distributions
if accepted rows collapse to one source, route to source-balanced expanded mining rather than training
if accepted rows are source-diverse, route to result audit before any objective or training step

training_stage.stage_objective: materialize terminal-boundary wrong-history outcome degradation without changing or training the actor
admission_evidence: M1226 exported 274 candidates across 110 physical pairs and passed source-diversity gates
M1222 showed action divergence but no outcome degradation under source geometry
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: balanced accepted wrong-history rows are source-diverse or the negative result is classified
next audit or fallback route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1227 can show wrong-history outcome sensitivity only after obstacle relocation; it still cannot by itself prove general recurrent belief.
history_necessity_tests: wrong_matched_history relocation replay over matched source candidates
source-diversity gate on accepted wrong-history rows
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: A positive result may support bounded outcome-level causal-history evidence on materialized terminal-boundary rows, not paper-level self-ID.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If relocation fails, record the negative result and route to stronger terminal/fault source distributions rather than weakening gates or training.
allowed_claims: bounded terminal-boundary materialization evidence if source-diverse accepted rows appear
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level result claim

hypothesis: Bounded obstacle/timing relocation can turn M1226 source-diverse action-divergent wrong-history candidates into source-diverse terminal-margin or success-critical rows.
success_criteria: source budget and candidate selection pass before replay
accepted wrong-history rows, if any, are reported with source-diversity accounting
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next audit or fallback route is selected
failure_criteria: accepted rows are claimed without source-diversity accounting
single-source active-set rows are treated as proof
